title: Python: Stack and Queue
description: Write a Python program implementing a stack (LIFO) and queue (FIFO) using lists and collections.deque.

codeTemplate.py:
from collections import deque

print("Stack (LIFO):")
stack = []
for item in ['a', 'b', 'c']:
    stack.append(item)
    print(f"  Push: {item}")
while stack:
    print(f"  Pop: {stack.pop()}")

print("\nQueue (FIFO):")
queue = deque()
for item in ['x', 'y', 'z']:
    queue.append(item)
    print(f"  Enqueue: {item}")
while queue:
    print(f"  Dequeue: {queue.popleft()}")

verificationTest: output.includes('Stack (LIFO):') && output.includes('Push: a') && output.includes('Pop: c') && output.includes('Queue (FIFO):')
